description: ClauseLens document taxonomy. File format (pdf, docx, jpg...) is NOT part of a document type; it is recorded separately on the document.

categories.name: Government
categories.description: Documents issued by a government, ministry, department or public authority.

categories.name: Legal / Contracts
categories.description: Agreements and contracts between parties, and terms that bind users of a service.

categories.name: Employment
categories.description: Documents about a job: offers, contracts, HR policies, warnings and exit letters.

categories.name: Court / Judicial
categories.description: Documents produced by or filed in courts and tribunals.

categories.name: Corporate / Company
categories.description: Documents of companies: constitution, resolutions, reports, policies and commercial agreements.

categories.name: Public Notices
categories.description: Notices addressed to the public: recruitment, exams, admissions, auctions, utilities, advisories.

categories.name: Financial
categories.description: Loans, insurance, invoices, tax and bank documents.

categories.name: Property
categories.description: Documents about land and buildings: sale, lease, registration, possession, tax.

categories.name: Education
categories.description: Documents of schools and universities: admissions, rules, scholarships, fees, hostels.

categories.name: Policy / Regulatory
categories.description: Policies, rules, regulations, standards and guidelines that set requirements.

categories.name: Other Official Documents
categories.description: Official documents that do not fit another category, or cannot be classified with confidence.
